Stash_ISA_Stash_RiversideW1_t2: they must be staying in a farm nearby
Stash_ISA_Stash_RosewoodE1_t1: Danger: Survivors may be escaping inmates
Stash_ISA_Stash_Westpoint1_t3: Every town had a hoarder, I just need to find where they lived.
Stash_DWAP_10_text1: fallout shelter stairs behind security office
Stash_DWAP_31_text2: Make your way to the library in the basement
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap1_Text2: I responded to a reported robbery. The suspect seemed strange from the start.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap1_Text3: When I arrived, I ordered him to freeze. He ignored me and reached for the device on his waist.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap1_Text4: I thought he was reaching for a weapon and had no choice but to fire. The bullet passed through his left leg.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap1_Text5: He was still conscious, so we transported him to the infirmary at Rosewood Prison.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap1_Text6: The suspect's accomplice fled northwest. Brandenburg PD has been notified.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap1_Text8: Urgent notice from Louisville HQ. The government has ordered the immediate recovery of the device.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap2_Text1: I apprehended the suspect Rosewood PD alerted us about. He is now being held at Brandenburg Prison.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap2_Text2: Strangely, they put him straight into an underground solitary cell... What the hell did he do?
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap2_Text3: That device he had was something else.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap2_Text4: The moment he put his hand on the device at his waist, he vanished right before my eyes!
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap2_Text5: Fortunately, I could hear a mechanical hum. When I focused, I could make out his outline and keep track of him...
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap2_Text6: Rosewood PD seems to have its hands full, and Louisville HQ has not stopped calling.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap2_Text7: What the hell is going on...?
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap3_Text1: Two devices, held by Rosewood and Brandenburg authorities, should be recovered without incident.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap3_Text2: They are classified, so personnel from HQ will be dispatched to recover them.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap3_Text3: The remaining device is in the hands of Spiffo's CEO. We have orders to recover it immediately.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap3_Text4: Spiffo's is already suspected of involvement in the outbreak, and its CEO still refuses our recovery request.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap3_Text5: If necessary, we may have to take it by force...
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap3_Text6: That damn raccoon bastard... He really went too far this time.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap4_Text1: At a military research facility far west of here, there are development documents for the advanced technology used in those devices.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap4_Text2: With that knowledge, mindless zombies would be nothing to fear.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap4_Text3: I do not care who finds them. Please use them to strike back at the zombies that took my family...
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap4_Text4: But the military can no longer be trusted.
Stash_P4StealthCamoMap4_Text5: To keep it from falling into the wrong hands, I leave behind only a cipher.
